from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
# Try to hit the generic resampler with a large width and nonstandard but accepted factors.
img=Image.new('CMYK',(511,17),(0,0,0,0))
img.save('/workspace/widecmyk.jpg',format='JPEG',quality=95,subsampling=0)
b=bytearray(Path('/workspace/widecmyk.jpg').read_bytes())
sof=b.find(b'\xff\xc0')
for i,v in enumerate([0x41,0x11,0x11,0x11]):
    b[sof+10+i*3]=v
Path('/workspace/widecmyk.bin').write_bytes(b)
print('len',len(b),'sof',sof)
PY
